Interface MediaEncoder

All Superinterfaces:
AutoCloseable
All Known Implementing Classes:
FfmpegMediaEncoder, GifMediaEncoder
public interface MediaEncoder extends AutoCloseable
A streaming media encoder interface for exporting animated frame sequences.

Call finish() only after every frame has been written in order.
